The stack writes configuration to .local-stack.env, but no task loads that file into Expo or the test processes, leaving getConfig() without the URLs and key required for the smoke flow.

The location-denied flow promises a private result, but createListen requires coordinates and the portal table makes lat/lon non-null, so the plan needs an executable private-recording path that does not invent coordinates or require a backend change.
The local host allowlist excludes laptop LAN addresses, so Task 18's physical-phone build cannot connect to the prescribed laptop stack on the same network.

Task 18 consumes local and staging EAS profiles that no task creates, and sets APP_ENV while the configuration guard reads EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV, leaving device builds and staging configuration undefined.
Place and Today use node_follows even though the spec's portal contract source journalFollows.js uses journal_follows, so app follows and followed-place feeds will disagree with the portal.
The Big Bend bounding-box test expects all three seeded nodes even though Task 4 places one in Colorado, so correct geographic filtering cannot pass the stated assertion.

The upload-failure test targets separate uploadAudio and createListen functions without a production orchestration function, so it can pass merely because the test never calls createListen and does not protect ListenFlow's upload-before-insert ordering.
No task creates docs/api-contract.md with portal source paths and pinned commits as required by spec §3, leaving the promised backend contract deliverable missing.

Task 11 omits a modify target for scripts/fakes/server.mjs despite requiring the hold- rule, and Task 17 similarly omits the smoke-test file it extends, leaving required task mutations outside their typed Files targets.
